title: Soveraeign Domain Owners
description: Who is accountable for each domain, what they were asked to do, what they may spend, by when, and who checks it. Policy input authored by the owner; the Registry Service reads it and would later hold it as owner-record. This table grants nothing: required_authority names the grant an owner would need, never one it holds. An owner and its witness may never be the same participant.

subject_kind.description: service means services/<domain>/contracts/service.json must exist; concern means the domain owns repository artifacts without being a declared service.

witness.description: The participant that checks this owner's work. Never the owner itself: a build report cannot witness itself.

mandate.description: What the owner was asked to produce, in one sentence, in the owner's own words.

requirements.description: The PRD requirements this domain answers. Each id must appear in PRD.md.

deadline.description: The date the mandate is due, as YYYY-MM-DD. A deadline is required: an owner without one cannot be declared.

schedule.description: The .claude/schedules declaration that fires this owner's work, or null while nothing fires it.

required_authority.description: The grant this owner would need to do consequential work. Naming it here does not hold it.
